Title: Virtual Machines support VM Agents for Windows and Linux

Body.Content: VM Agent support for IaaS Virtual Machines helps you manage your Windows and Linux VMs. It's a lightweight process that runs inside your virtual machines - use it to install and manage your extensions (software that extends the functionality of a VM and helps you work through common management tasks).
